manifest.name: RiPlay
manifest.description: Your RiPlay library (local files, Music Vault and direct URLs) streamed through the RiPlay bridge: multi-room playback stays on Music Assistant, the audio comes straight from your own device.

bridge_host.label: RiPlay bridge host
bridge_host.description: LAN address of the RiPlay device, as shown in the app's server/relay settings (e.g. 192.168.1.10).

bridge_port.label: Bridge port
bridge_port.description: Port of RiPlay's server: the same port serves the bridge and the streaming relay.

api_token.label: API token
api_token.description: Token shown in RiPlay's server/relay settings: it authorizes both /api/v1 and the streaming URLs.
